result.finding: Security is implemented via Azure Managed Identity (MSI) for passwordless authentication and TLS encryption for database connections
evidence: application.properties: authentication=ActiveDirectoryMSI - uses Azure Managed Identity for SQL authentication (no passwords in code)
application.properties: encrypt=true - TLS encryption enforced for all database connections
application.properties: trustServerCertificate=false - server certificate validation enabled
MainSQL.java: msiClientId appended to connection string for user-assigned Managed Identity
No Spring Security or JWT dependencies in pom.xml (console app, no HTTP security needed)
No hardcoded passwords or credentials found in source code
values: Transport: TLS encrypted connection to Azure SQL Database (port 1433)
Credential management: no secrets in code, identity-based access
